Pinned official html-to-image 1.11.13 ESM and type declarations from npm. MIT license included. PROVENANCE.json records the verified package SHA-512 and distributed file SHA-256 hashes. One documented patch in clone-node.js yields to the event loop every 32 nodes, enabling cancellation of large SVG captures; its original file hash is retained under patches. All other package files are unchanged. Used only for self-contained SVG with HTML foreignObject; compatibility varies outside web browsers. No install scripts or shared dependency changes.
